content: वितान {%a.%} .²1 Vacant, empty. .²2 Pithless. .²3 Dismayed, sad; क्षितिपतिमण्डलमन्यतो वितानम् <ls>R. 6. 86</ls>. .²4 Dull, stupid. .²5 Wicked, abandoned. .{@-नः, -नम्@} .²1 Spreading out, expansion, extension; ब्रह्मावर्ते यत्र यजन्ति यज्ञैर्यज्ञेश्वरं यज्ञवितानविज्ञाः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 17. 33</ls>; विलुलितकमलौघः कीर्णवल्लीवितानः <ls>Śi. 11. 28</ls>; <ls>Ki. 7. 19</ls>. .²2 An awning, a canopy; विद्युलेखाकनकरुचिरं श्रीवितानं ममाभ्रम् <ls>V. 4. 13</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 39</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 42</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 50</ls>. .²3 A cushion. .²4 A collection, quantity, an assemblage; प्रस्तारस्थगिता इवोन्मुखमणिज्योतिर्वितानैर्दिशः <ls>Māl. 6. 5</ls>; <ls>Ki. 17. 61</ls>. .²5 A sacrifice, an oblation; वितानेष्वप्येवं तव मम च सोमे विधिरभूत् <ls>Ve. 6. 30</ls>, <ls n="Ve.">3. 16</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 10</ls>. .²6 The sacrificial hearth or altar. .²7 Season, opportunity. .²8 Plenty, abundance. .²9 Performance, accomplishment. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Leisure, rest. .²2 A dual part of the elephantʼs head to which the hook is applied; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 12. 19</ls>.
